facts.business: Sea TV Network Limited operates in the broadcasting and media industry, integrating traditional broadcasting with digital ecosystems, OTT services, AI, and analytics for content curation and audience engagement.

auditor.name: M/s Doogar & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The company has not provided for interest on unsecured loans amounting to Rs 233.14 lacs for the financial year ended 31 March 2026, which is not in compliance with Ind AS 109. Had the interest been recognized, finance cost would have been higher by ₹233.14 lakhs, loss would have increased by the same amount, and current liabilities would have been higher by ₹233.14 lakhs.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to current liabilities (Rs 2105.90 Lacs) exceeding current assets (Rs 354.13 Lacs), negative net worth of ₹4,023.89 lakhs, significant operating losses, and substantial revenue decrease from Rs 613.69 lakhs to Rs 562.55 lakhs
Non-recognition of interest expense on unsecured loans (Rs 233.14 lacs) leading to qualified audit opinion
